patterns.note: Full-width sections with varying background treatments (hero image, solid white, solid dark, vibrant gradient) create distinct visual breaks.
Hero and main section headings use a very large, bold sans-serif font, often in all caps, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller body text.
A vibrant orange-to-pink gradient is used as a prominent background for the hero overlay and the entire footer section, contrasting with stark black and white content areas.

The hero section features large, overlapping text elements that scroll vertically at a different rate than the background image, creating a subtle parallax and content reveal effect as the user scrolls down.
A prominent call-to-action button ('OBTENIR MON PASS') remains sticky to the right side of the viewport throughout the page scroll, ensuring constant visibility.

The footer is a full-height, full-width section dominated by a large, left-aligned heading and the brand's signature gradient, making it a significant visual anchor rather than a typical compact footer.

technique_notes: The hero section combines a background image with an overlay that has a subtle gradient. Large, overlapping text elements are positioned within this hero, and as the user scrolls, these text elements translate vertically at a faster rate than the background image, creating a layered parallax effect that reveals the content below.
A fixed-position element is used for the call-to-action button, ensuring it stays anchored to the right edge of the viewport regardless of scroll depth.
Content sections transition by simply scrolling into view, relying on strong visual contrast in background colors and typography to define their boundaries.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are used for hero and section titles, with standard-sized body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for all interactive elements and content blocks, contributing to a clean, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing is used throughout, with airy sections for the hero and footer, and a more dense, grid-like arrangement for content listings.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, full-height gradient footer that acts as a major visual statement, rather than a utilitarian element. The dynamic, overlapping text treatment in the hero, combined with a sticky, ever-present CTA, also sets it apart from generic templates.
